title: Ethereal Eyes™ Eyeshadow Palette: The Original
descriptionHtml:
What it is: An iconic eye palette that tells Mario’s dream color story with 12 signature shades in glossy shimmer, sueded matte, and natural metallic finishes.

Ingredient Callouts: Free of parabens, formaldehydes, formaldehyde-releasing agents, phthalates, mineral oil, retinyl palmitate, oxybenzone, coal tar, hydroquinone, sulfates SLS & SLES, triclocarban, and triclosan. This product is also cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: Mario’s original Ethereal Eyes™ Palette is his artistic vision come to life. Inspired by the timeless beauty of the natural world around us, the 12 shades and three finishes work in perfect harmony together. Be your own artist: Create infinite looks from everyday ethereal to special occasion.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-Use any combination of shades to create an ethereal look, day or night. Each shadow offers sheer to buildable color.
-Use your favorite Makeup By Mario eyeshadow brush (sold separately) for flawless application.
-Pro tip: For the glossy shimmer formula, use your fingers to tap the wet-to-powder shadow onto lids. Head to Makeup By Mario’s Instagram to see Mario’s looks for inspiration.
Ingredients+
EE1:
Mica, Talc, Zinc Stearate, Boron Nitride, Nylon-12, Silica, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, Cellulose, Polyethylene, [May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140)].

EE2, EE4:
Dimethicone, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Mica, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Magnesium Myristate, Diisostearyl Malate, Silica, HDI/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Caprylyl Glycol, 1,2-Hexanediol, Tin Oxide, Acrylates Copolymer, Isododecane, [May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Bismuth Oxychloride (CI 77163)].

EE3, EE7:
Talc, Boron Nitride, Nylon-12, Silica, Mica, Cellulose, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Polyethylene, Zinc Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, Triethoxycaprylylsilane, [May Contain (+/-): Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Carmine (CI 75470), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140)].

EE5, EE10:
Talc, Mica, Boron Nitride, Silica, Nylon-12, Polyethylene, Zinc Stearate, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, [May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Ultramarines (CI 77007), Yellow 5 Lake (CI 19140].

EE6:
Dimethicone, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Mica, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Silica, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, HDI/Trimethylol Hexyllactone Crosspolymer, Dimethicone/Vinyl Dimethicone Crosspolymer, Magnesium Myristate, 1,2-Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol, Isododecane, Acrylates Copolymer, Tin Oxide, Talc, [May Contain (+/-): Bismuth Oxychloride (CI 77163), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].

EE8:
Boron Nitride, Mica, Talc, Nylon-12, Polyethylene, Cellulose, Zinc Stearate, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Silica, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, [May Contain (+/-): Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].

EE9:
Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Calcium Sodium Borosilicate, Zinc Stearate, Tin Oxide, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Caprylyl Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, Hexylene Glycol, Boron Nitride, Silica, Talc, [May Contain (+/-):Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891), Mica (CI 77019), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].

EE11:
Ethylhexyl Palmitate, Talc, Zinc Stearate, Calcium Aluminum Borosilicate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Caprylyl Glycol, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, Hexylene Glycol, Tin Oxide, Boron Nitride, Silica, [May Contain (+/-): Mica (CI 77019), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499), Titanium Dioxide (CI 77891)].

EE12:
Talc, Mica, Boron Nitride, Silica, Zinc Stearate, Nylon-12, Polyethylene, Cellulose, Octyldodecyl Stearoyl Stearate, Diisostearyl Malate, Sodium Dehydroacetate, Phenoxyethanol, Sorbic Acid, [May Contain (+/-): Manganese Violet (CI 77742), Iron Oxides (CI 77491, CI 77492, CI 77499)].
